name: Photos
description: Photo slideshow from a Google Photos album, with local and Immich fallback modes.

library.description: Photo source. Google Photos uses frame-core as an OAuth-backed local proxy.

transition.description: Deprecated — use transition_style. Still honored when transition_style is unset.

kenburns_duration.description: Ken Burns zoom duration in seconds (independent of interval_sec)

fade_duration_ms.description: Cross-fade / push transition length in milliseconds

caption_position.description: Where to show filename or EXIF description when available

immich_api_key.description: Immich API key with album/asset read scope

immich_album_id.description: Optional - restrict to one Immich album

google_album_id.description: Google Photos Library API album ID. If empty, app-created library photos are used.

google_client_id.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud.

google_client_secret_file.description: Path on the frame to a file containing the OAuth client secret.

google_refresh_token_file.description: Path on the frame to a file containing the OAuth refresh token.

google_max_items.description: Maximum Google Photos items to load into the slideshow.

local_index_url.description: URL returning a JSON array of image URLs (served by your reverse proxy or rclone http)
